attempts.summary: Configured sudo on node1 to log every sudo-invoked command (with user, timestamp, PWD) to /var/log/sudo-commands.log via /etc/sudoers.d/command-logging (Defaults logfile=... + Defaults !syslog), keeping those entries out of /var/log/secure, /var/log/messages, and the journal. Verified with root and a temporary test user, then restarted node1 and confirmed the config, log file, and correct behavior survived a real reboot (boot_id changed).
